description: Write a security.txt file (RFC 9116) from a contact, a review date and optional policy, thanks, encryption and canonical addresses, with what the RFC requires flagged. Send `today` to have the date checked. Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.

contact.description: Where to report a vulnerability. An email address or an https:// page with a form.

encryption.description: Encryption key. Where your PGP key is published. Optional.

expires.description: Review this file by. At most a year from now: an expired file is ignored. (YYYY-MM-DD)

languages.description: Languages you read. Codes separated by commas. Optional.

today.description: Today. To check the review date against. Optional. (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: generate_security_txt
title: Write a security.txt file
